title: PORT-BRANCH-claude-lesson-c: carry claude/lesson-c onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `claude/lesson-c` at af4b6eaab0 holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: deploy/migration-plan.mjs, seed/worker/test/migrations.test.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried claude/lesson-c
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 1 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M
